Q1.rationale: Segment 15 prohibits copying or reverse engineering any Proprietary Information, which covers the reverse engineering of objects embodying it in substance, though it speaks of information rather than objects.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: Segment 25 requires return or destruction of Proprietary Information on the Disclosing Party's written request, not upon termination of the Agreement, and the NDA has no termination clause.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segment 19 states that the disclosure is made without granting any right or license.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: The NDA contains no provision restricting disclosure of the fact that the agreement was agreed or negotiated; segment 34 only concerns supersession of prior negotiations.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q5.rationale: Segment 9 defines Proprietary Information as any information relating to Last Man Stands, and segment 18 refers to customer lists, accounts and procedures, so the scope is not limited to technical information.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: Segment 9 defines Proprietary Information by reference to what is disclosed, with no requirement that it be expressly designated, which is incompatible with a designation requirement.
Q6.label: Contradiction

Q7.rationale: Segments 17, 18 and 19 set time-limited obligations (eighteen months, three years and five years) that continue after execution, which operate as survival of some obligations, though termination is not expressly addressed.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Segment 23(iv) excludes information independently developed without use of the Disclosing Party's Proprietary Information.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Segment 25 requires all Proprietary Information and any copies to be returned or destroyed on request, with no right to retain any of it, which is incompatible with retention.
Q9.label: Contradiction

Q10.rationale: The NDA does not specifically mention verbally conveyed information; segment 9 covers information disclosed in general terms without referring to oral disclosure.
Q10.label: NotMentioned

Q11.rationale: Segment 17 prohibits the Receiving Party from soliciting or hiring any employee, contractor or player of the Disclosing Party for eighteen months.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: Segment 16 contemplates disclosure of Proprietary Information to employees, agents and sub-contractors who must sign a nondisclosure agreement.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 15 prohibits copying Proprietary Information without any exception, which is incompatible with a permitted copy, although segment 25 refers to copies already made.
Q13.label: Contradiction

Q14.rationale: Segment 24 permits disclosures required by law or court order only if the Disclosing Party is allowed to seek a protective order, which requires prior notice.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: Segment 22 excludes information rightfully disclosed to the Receiving Party by a third party, which implies the Receiving Party may acquire such information.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 16 contemplates disclosure of Proprietary Information to the Receiving Party's employees who sign a nondisclosure agreement.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 14 prohibits any use of Proprietary Information except to evaluate internally the relationship with the Disclosing Party.
Q17.label: Entailment
